title: Parking License Waitlist Order, Offer Window and Per-Lease Limits
content:
Leasing office standard for the Parking License: how many licenses of each product one lease may hold, how requests on each product's waitlist are ordered, and how long an offer of a space stays open.

| Parking product | Licenses of this product one lease may hold | Waitlist order | Calendar days an offer of a space stays open |
|---|---|---|---|
| Surface Unreserved Permit | 2 | by waitlist date | 3 |
| Surface Reserved Space | 1 | by waitlist date | 3 |
| Covered Carport Space | 1 | by waitlist date | 3 |
| Structured Garage Space | 2 | by waitlist date | 3 |
| EV Charging Reserved Space | 1 | by waitlist date | 3 |
| Private Detached Garage | 1 | by waitlist date | 3 |

The waitlist date is the date the parking request was received. Every product orders its waitlist by that date and holds an offer open for 3 calendar days.

## Points of comparison

- A lease may hold up to 2 licenses of the Surface Unreserved Permit and up to 2 of the Structured Garage Space.
- Of the Surface Reserved Space, Covered Carport Space, EV Charging Reserved Space and Private Detached Garage, a lease may hold 1 each.
